programme.title: Inside Africa: Namibia's Culinary and Winemaking Excellence
programme.desc: Namibia's breathtaking landscapes draw travelers from around the world, but beyond its iconic desert landscapes and wildlife lies a new story of culinary and winemaking excellence. Through Wilderness Safari's pioneering hospitality and training initiatives, Neuras' award-winning wines, and the rise of visionary young chefs, Namibia is blending sustainability, culture, and innovation to redefine world-class wining and dining.

programme.title: Marketplace Africa: Nigeria E1 Boat Racing/Developing Nigeria's Waterways; Samer Kassem/Marketplace Europe: World Travel Market
programme.desc: In Lagos Nigeria, 17% of the state is composed of waterways and lagoons. But water transportation is highly underutilized, despite poor road infrastructure and traffic congestion. Now, the state actively seeking to develop its waterways network through public ferries and private operators as well as a partnership with the international boat racing franchise E1, with the first African E1 event taking place in October. E1 is also looking to grow their presence on the continent through digital education and outreach, something that is launching in tandem with the event in October. We take a look at the challenges and opportunities of developing Lagos' waterways, and the potential economic boost of tapping into the region's blue economy. Also, Aspen Global CEO Samer Kassem sits down to discuss the biopharmaceutical giant's growth strategy and the markets he believes will grow in the coming years./The World Travel Market unites industry leaders to take on the biggest challenges and trends in global tourism. From AI and sustainability, to customer service and changing traveler demands, we speak to some of the key figures in European travel to find out how our vacations will evolve in the coming years.

programme.title: Turbo F.A.S.T.

programme.title: Where's Wally?

programme.title: Where's Wally?
programme.desc: Whitebeard uses the Grow Key to make himself 40' tall. But the key breaks! So the Wanderers take the key to Wizard Fix-It in Moscow. programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective
programme.desc: It's the Toyland Circus and all the toys are rehearsing an act - all except Smartysaurus, who rushes away, apparently too shy to take part. Noddy has to find a way to help Smartysaurus find an act for the circus.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective
programme.desc: Action-hero Deltoid suddenly loses all his strength and finds himself totally helpless. Noddy quickly starts an investigation: How can he help Deltoid get his strength back?

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car
programme.desc: PC Pete and Nick are up at Silver hatch giving the cars their road tests. Is Maxi really going to be as good as he says he is or will he be unpleasantly surprised?

programme.title: Raa Raa the Noisy Lion
programme.desc: An over enthusiastic Raa Raa breaks Pias new Jungle Gym but he manages to fix it so everyone can have a turn.

programme.title: Raa Raa the Noisy Lion

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse
programme.desc: Gabby brings DJ Catnip a microphone for him to use in the big music show, but he has some terrible news: he lost his groove! As they go, Gabby uses the microphone to record sounds from the Gabby Cats’ everyday activities that culminate into a new song that gets DJ his groove back just in time for the show! In our Gabby Cat of the Day Segment, Gabby sings a song!

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse
programme.desc: When Gabby unboxes a recipe for dandelion soup and a soup bowl, she discovers Kitty Fairy is sick! With the help of all the Gabby Cats, they water the Singing Flowers, help the Rainbow Kitty Bushes regain their color, and sing some fussy Itty Bitty Blossoms a lullaby. For our Gabby Cat of the Day segment, Kitty Fairy sings a song!

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business
programme.desc: A brainwashed Boss Baby breaks free from overly sanitized Bubbeezee products. He rallies the Playgroup Babies to run the company out of business by breaking every product in town.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree
programme.desc: Jealous of the Thunder Sisters, the men on the farm undergo a series of difficult initiation rituals to try and join the exclusive tribe of women.

programme.title: DRAGONS 9 REALMS
programme.desc: Tom’s leadership abilities come into question by Eugene when his decisions lead to failure while attempting to confront Buzzsaw.

programme.title: \t Abominable and The Invisible City
programme.desc: \"The crew tracks down the source of the havoc-wreaking robot “Qilin” and winds up trapped by Mr. Lung, the Minticon-using candymaker who disappeared in Season\n1. programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse

programme.title: CSI S4 E01 - Assume Nothing
programme.desc: Season 4 begins with terrific back-to-back episodes involving serial killers (\"Assume Nothing\" / \"For All Our Country\"). There's a new politically minded sheriff in town and in \"Invisible Evidence\" he's ticked off that the CSI's can't get enough evidence to convict a rapist/murderer. Also, Nick and Sara buck for the same promotion. Along the way there are plenty of quirky cases: one involving a museum robbery (\"Suckers\") and one involving a dead juror (\"Eleven Angry Jurors\"). Grissom travels to a small town with plenty of secrets to solve a murder in \"Jackpot,\" Catherine dates a younger man in \"Early Rollout,\" and Sara works a case involving a woman strikingly similar to herself in \"Butterflied.\" There's also plenty of kinkiness in \"Fur and Loathing\" and tragedy \"Bad Words.\".

programme.title: Sari Saring Sine: Hindi Pa Tapos ang Laban
programme.desc: Fernando Poe Jr. stars as Carding Villamar, a city professional who returns to their hometown of Evangelista after learning of his brother's untimely demise. As a series of events unfold, he soon discovers that his brother didn't succumb to a heart attack as he was made to believe. He was shot in cold blood for refusing to sell his land to a powerful congressman. With a town muted and crippled by fear, the congressman's henchmen move unhampered to silence Carding and his brother's orphaned family as well. Big mistake. Armed with only a crusty riffle and a whole ton of rage. Carding sets out to right the wrong and exact vengeance for the murder of his brother. That is, if he survives the hot pursuits of bounty hunters, the militia and the police who are all in the congressman's payroll.

programme.desc: Daniel berupaya untuk membantu seorang siswa baru belajar. Miguel memulai hubungan baru, sementara Johnny mencoba memperbaiki hubungannya. Ketegangan yang terjadi antara kedua dojo semakin meningkat.

programme.title: Cobra Kai
programme.desc: Murid-murid Daniel diajarkan untuk mengatasi dendam mereka. Johnny meninggalkan dojo untuk sementara waktu, sementara Kreese menggunakan pengaruhnya.

programme.title: Cobra Kai
programme.desc: Untuk mempersiapkan murid-muridnya, Daniel mencoba beberapa metode pelatihan baru. Miguel mempraktikkan sebuah pelajaran baru. Johnny membuat sebuah keputusan sulit namun penting yang mempengaruhi Cobra Kai.

programme.title: Cobra Kai
programme.desc: Daniel berusaha berbaikan dengan Amanda, sementara Johnny menggunakan sebuah aplikasi kencan. Ketegangan terjadi saat Miguel, Samantha, Robby dan Tory bertemu.

programme.title: Cobra Kai
programme.desc: Johnny mencoba berkencan, sementara Daniel dan Amanda menikmati kencan nan romantis. Sebuah upaya untuk menyatukan murid-murid dari kedua dojo menjadi bumerang saat permusuhan para remaja justru memanas.

programme.title: Cobra Kai
programme.desc: Ini hari pertama sekolah di SMA West Valley, namun ketegangan antara kedua dojo belum juga mereda seiring berakhirnya musim panas. Persaingan antara Daniel dan Johnny mencapai puncaknya.

programme.title: Cobra Kai
programme.desc: Miguel tengah berjuang untuk bertahan hidup, Robby menghilang, sementara reputasi Daniel dan Johnny hancur saat masyarakat mendapatkan informasi terkait perkelahian di West Valley.

programme.title: Cobra Kai
programme.desc: Daniel dan Johnny bekerja sama untuk mencari Robby. Miguel menghadapi masa depan yang tidak pasti. Kreese berusaha untuk membuat Tory kembali ke Cobra Kai.

programme.title: Cobra Kai
programme.desc: Citra buruk Daniel di mata publik berdampak negatif pada penjualannya, hingga memicu tawaran akuisisi. Johnny berusaha mengumpulkan dana untuk operasi Miguel.

programme.title: Cobra Kai
programme.desc: Setelah menghadiri pertemuan penting di Jepang, Daniel kembali mengunjungi kampung halaman Tn. Miyagi di Okinawa. Johnny berusaha memperbaiki hubungan dengan Robby.

programme.title: Cobra Kai
programme.desc: Di Okinawa, Daniel menghabiskan waktu bersama seorang teman lama dan seorang musuh lama, yang memiliki banyak hal untuk diajarkan kepadanya. Persaingan kedua dojo tersebut semakin sengit.

programme.title: Cobra Kai
programme.desc: Miguel membantu Johnny merancang unggahan media sosial yang sempurna. Kreese mencari calon anggota baru, sementara Daniel dan Amanda berusaha menutup Cobra Kai.

programme.title: Cobra Kai
programme.desc: Daniel menghabiskan waktu bersama putrinya, Sam, yang mengalami trauma. Johnny berencana untuk membuka dojo karate baru tapi ia kesulitan menemukan nama yang keren.

programme.title: Cobra Kai
programme.desc: Setelah diberitahu bahwa Turnamen Karate All Valley tahun ini dibatalkan, ketiga guru bela diri yang saling berkompetisi menghadiri rapat dewan kota untuk mencegahnya.

programme.title: Cobra Kai
programme.desc: Suasana romantis dan perayaan Natal di Valley semakin terasa. Daniel dan Miguel menemukan kesamaan yang tak terduga, dan para anggota Cobra Kai pergi untuk menjalani sebuah misi.

programme.title: Cobra Kai
programme.desc: Keadaan mulai membaik saat pesta Natal klub, tapi sebuah serangan brutal yang dilakukan oleh murid-murid Kreese menyebabkan pengkhianatan dan munculnya aliansi baru.

programme.title: Cobra Kai
programme.desc: 34 tahun setelah kalah dalam Kejuaraan Karate All Valley, Johnny Lawrence memutuskan untuk membuka kembali Dojo Cobra Kai sementara lawannya di sekolah, Daniel LaRusso, menjalankan sebuah bisnis otomotif yang sukses.

programme.title: Cobra Kai
programme.desc: Daniel merasa kesal saat mengetahui bahwa Dojo Cobra Kai yang baru telah dibuka. Johnny mengetahui bahwa dojo miliknya harus memenuhi beberapa persyaratan keselamatan sebelum ia dapat mulai mengajar.

programme.title: Cobra Kai
programme.desc: Miguel membantu Johnny mengiklankan Cobra Kai di sebuah halaman situs. Daniel setuju untuk datang ke sebuah pesta dansa Halloween agar ia bisa mengawasi putrinya.

programme.title: Cobra Kai
programme.desc: Robbie tengah bersitegang dengan ayahnya. Johnny berencana menutup Cobra Kai setelah Miguel terluka. Hubungan Samantha dan Kyler di ambang kehancuran. Sementara, sebuah papan reklame yang dirusak membuat Daniel marah.

programme.title: Cobra Kai
programme.desc: Cobra Kai mendapatkan murid kedua. Daniel menyusun rencana rumit untuk membalas dendam pada Johnny. Miguel membela Samantha saat berhadapan dengan Kyler di jam istirahat makan siang.

programme.title: Cobra Kai
programme.desc: Kelas dojo Johnny menarik sekelompok orang dengan karakter nan unik sementara putranya, Robby, yang memiliki motif tersembunyi, mendapatkan pekerjaan baru. Samantha mendapat teman baru di kelas sains.

programme.title: Cobra Kai
programme.desc: Saat Johnny mengetahui Cobra Kai dilarang mengikuti Turnamen All Valley, ia menghadap Dewan Kota. Miguel mengajak Samantha berkencan. Robbie belajar dari Daniel saat teman-temannya berencana mencuri dari LaRusso Auto.

programme.title: Cobra Kai
programme.desc: Johnny mempersiapkan murid-muridnya di Cobra Kai untuk mengikuti Turnamen Karate All Valley berikutnya dan ia pun terinspirasi untuk menata kembali hidupnya. Daniel masih belum mengetahui latar belakang murid barunya.

programme.title: Cobra Kai
programme.desc: Tindakan sembrono Louie memaksa Johnny dan Daniel untuk mengenang masa lalu mereka. Murid-murid Cobra Kai merencanakan balas dendam terhadap anak-anak yang populer. Miguel merasa jengkel dengan Samantha.

programme.title: Cobra Kai
programme.desc: Hari penyelenggaraan Turnamen Karate All Valley 2018 dan Cobra Kai bertekad untuk menang. Robbie mendaftar tanpa afiliasi. Seseorang yang tak asing dari masa lalu hadir kembali.

programme.title: Cobra Kai
programme.desc: Setelah kemenangan Cobra Kai di Kejuaraan Karate Under 18 All Valley, Johnny mempertanyakan filosofi dojo-nya dan berhadapan dengan sosok dari masa lalunya.

programme.title: Cobra Kai
programme.desc: Saat Daniel mulai mengajar murid-murid karate pertamanya, ia mempertanyakan apakah ia bisa mengisi posisi Tn. Miyagi. Johnny menciptakan beberapa metode pelatihan tak lazim dengan bantuan dari sumber yang tidak biasa.

programme.title: Cobra Kai
programme.desc: Daniel melakukan segala cara untuk merekrut murid-murid baru ke Miyagi Do. Johnny memikirkan beberapa hubungan penting dalam hidupnya dan menanggapi promosi dojo milik Daniel dengan caranya sendiri.

programme.title: Spectre
programme.desc: James Bond, the renowned spy, gets a cryptic message from an evil organisation. However, things quickly become complicated when he tries to unravel the mystery.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible
programme.desc: Ethan Hunt, an elite intelligence agent, is branded a traitor following a disastrous mission in Prague. He recruits a team of operatives to help him retrieve a computer disk that can clear his name.

programme.title: Apocalypto
programme.desc: A mettlesome tribesman must do whatever it takes to protect himself and his family from a multitude of threats during the Mayan civilisation's waning years.

programme.title: The Hobbit: The Desolation of Smaug
programme.desc: As Gandalf learns of the resurrection of the great evil at Dol Guldur, Bilbo Baggins joins the Dwarves on their quest to the Lonely Mountain, unaware of the fierce beast that awaits them.

programme.title: Transformers
programme.desc: When Sam Witwicky buys a car, he unwittingly involves himself in a clash between Autobots and Decepticons over a device that can create life.

programme.title: Evil Dead
programme.desc: Five friends decide to spend a weekend in a remote cabin located deep in the forest. When they accidentally summon a dormant demon, they strive to survive its evil ploys.

programme.title: Spider-Man 3
programme.desc: A symbiote bonds with Peter Parker, intensifying his abilities and aggression. Now, he must face the challenges that his new powers bring while simultaneously fighting new villains.

programme.title: Southpaw
programme.desc: After a devastating accident shatters his world, a once-celebrated champion boxer spirals into a destructive abyss. Subsequently, he decides to fight for his daughter and revive his fading career.

programme.title: Let Me In
